### Clearer keep-awake settings
- Clearly separates the keep-awake explanation from the reminder that your screen still dims at the chosen time. - Updates this wording and layout in all 12 languages.
### 更清楚的保持唤醒说明
- 将保持唤醒的用途与调暗提醒分开显示，明确开启后屏幕仍会按设定调暗。 - 同步更新全部 12 种语言的说明与排版。

### First release
- Automatically check for and download updates for direct installations. - Dim the screen when you step away, then restore brightness with a mouse movement or keypress. - Remember your choice to keep the computer awake, and restore it when Doze opens. This also prevents automatic sleep during downloads and exports. - Enjoy day and night artwork, Liquid Glass buttons, a clearer app icon and more room for the landscape. - Choose from 12 languages. Activity information stays on your Mac.
### 首次发布
- 直接下载版现在会自动检查并下载更新。 - 离开电脑后自动调暗屏幕，回来动动鼠标或按键就恢复亮度。 - 记住你保持电脑唤醒的选择，并在 Doze 打开时恢复；下载和导出期间也不会因自动睡眠而中断。 - 提供柔和的昼夜外观、液态玻璃按钮、更清晰的应用图标，以及更舒展的树林背景。 - 支持 12 种语言，活动信息只留在本机。
